field_mappings.scope: One UUID per physical unit. A make/model catalog ID is a separate reference. Example: 3D recipe and runs tab.
Reference the existing equipment_id. Do not mint a physical-machine identity for a catalog model.
Resolvable metadata-record address. UUID itself is neither a network address nor an access credential.
Control endpoint and protocol, separate from the metadata registry address. Resolve credentials separately; never embed them in the public recipe.
Reference the exact controller/adapter artifact, version and checksum. API credentials remain separate.
Versioned model-bound Position/Fiber/Direction definitions; preserve definition artifacts and checksums.
sha256:<64 lowercase hex> identifies one frozen manifest revision. Hash exact file bytes, outside the token wrapper.
Content URL on the manifest MediaObject. Plan references that artifact. Resolve and verify before use.
Human-readable revision inside the manifest. Any byte or linked-artifact checksum change creates a new recipe token.
Recipe can coordinate several roles. Each run binds every role to a physical machine_token.
Required for 3D manufacturing. Reference CAD/mesh/design artifact, checksum, coordinate frame and orientation.
Physical dimensions and tolerances carry explicit units. Preserve dimensional scale and coordinate transforms.
Optional learned representation: retain vector artifact, decoder checkpoint, K/L, dtype, normalization and reconstruction validation. Does not replace the authoritative design.
Declare material, utility or data roles. Step input references map to p-plan:hasInputVar on the Step.
Optional at recipe level. Bind sufficient feedstock properties, batch and quantity at run launch when omitted here.
Each step has a stable local ID and belongs to this recipe revision. The plan is distinct from its executions.
Link child step to prerequisite step. Independent branches remain parallel. Preserve official spelling isPreceededBy.
Several ordered sequences can belong to one step or machine role. Local sequence/action IDs are not extra primary token tiers.
Bind Position -> Fiber -> Direction and typed parameters to an evidenced model-bound command. Illustrative labels are not manufacturer facts.
Nominal recipe settings. Record quantity kind/value/unit and source; unresolved settings remain explicitly unresolved.
Model-bound entry states, resource constraints and interlocks; controller must observe them before dispatch.
Observable end/error signals and acceptance conditions, separate from expected material properties.
Intended specimens/data with shape and acceptance criteria. Expectations are not measured results.
One UUID per specific attempt. Same recipe, repeated runs: different UUIDs. Preserve retries as distinct attempts.
Foreign-key reference to exact recipe token. For an actual execution, prov:hadPlan belongs on its qualified Association, not directly on an Activity. Planned runs remain planning records.
Bind roles to machine UUIDs and configurations. Use prov:used only for observed actual usage, not a planned assignment.
Material ID, batch, unit-aware quantity and properties. Distinguish planned, verified loaded and actually consumed amounts.
Bind required gases, cooling, power or other utilities to their properties and unit-aware settings. Verify live conditions before dispatch.
Bind required toolpaths, qualified build programs and other input data by role, artifact URI and checksum.
Run-specific settings. Preserve intended versus observed settings and the material-specific qualified parameter artifact.
One record per sequence occurrence, with its own local execution ID. Assert Activity only for actual executions; planned entries are intent records.
planned / ready / running / completed / failed / aborted. Readiness requires an executable, fully bound plan and runtime verification.
Actual timestamp including timezone. Leave absent for an unexecuted planned run.
Actual ending timestamp, including timezone. Do not invent an ending for a planned or running record.
Planned specimen IDs link to recipe geometry and criteria. They do not assert that material has been manufactured.
Only actual specimens link back to the run Activity. Keep measured geometry/properties and evidence for each specimen.
Logs, programs, data and results. Each referenced artifact has URI and exact-byte SHA-256. Supporting checksums do not add a fourth primary token tier.
Record deviations and evidence separately from the frozen recipe. Changing a record does not change the run UUID.

workflow_token_extension.scope: Additive schema and illustrative linked records. Existing catalog records, saved workflows and evidence are not migrated. No autonomous executor is implemented.
